items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) officially active for SNF return from ACL; decision left up to him after murky status and PS elevations.
items.why: Game-time; full practice week but late decision; 6/9 for 69 yds
items.implication: Start in all formats; monitor post-game recovery

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled OUT Week 1 with wrist injury; initial diagnosis fractured wrist, several weeks, further MRI.
items.implication: Multi-week absence opens BAL WR/TE targets
items.opportunity: Increased role for Likely and other receivers

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play / inactive for Week 1. Status affects projections for teammates like Travis Etienne.
items.why: Weekend reports and confirmation he did not play
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets/snaps for Etienne as lead back

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play and officially ACTIVE for Week 1 debut vs Chargers after limited practices.
items.why: Weekend reports + beat confirmation; played 11 rushes 41 yds TD + 2 rec
items.implication: Startable RB2/flex with lead-back upside despite split
items.opportunity: Goal-line and route work in debut; monitor ankle for volume expansion

items.text: Ladd McConkey (chest) left early Week 1 after 5/7 82 yds TD; no immediate return, status for Week 2 TBD.
items.why: Big hit third quarter; questionable return then out
items.implication: LAC WR volume redistribution if misses time

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) left early Week 1 after big half (5/6 150 yds TD); will have MRI, questionable Week 2. Same hamstring previously rehabbed.
items.why: Exited game; MRI Monday; Florio report
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2; volume to other BAL pass-catchers

items.text: Malik Nabers active: start wherever rostered despite decoy risk.
items.why: Active + talent; inactives showed no major decoy elevation impact

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE: risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere; wouldn't activate if worried about injury (Cardinals caveat).
items.why: Active confirmation + preseason talent; risk on ankle/volume
items.opportunity: Lead back potential despite Allgeier split

items.text: AJ Brown (high ankle sprain) will not need surgery but sidelined 4-6 weeks; placed on IR context.
items.implication: Long absence for NE WR1; handcuff/backup targets rise
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other NE WRs

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active for Week 1.
items.why: Expected per ETR reports; Schefter confirmation
items.implication: Full WR role in high-scoring Bears offense

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee, meniscus trim Tuesday) OUT Week 1; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 vs Chargers. Spotted walking unaided postgame.
items.why: Meniscus procedure; team optimistic short absence
items.implication: TE1 stash; Michael Mayer elevated short-term

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN well under way.
Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want as much Bears offense as possible despite Week 1 target questions vs Kmet/Raymond.
items.why: Preseason belief in Bears offense volume; Week 1 weirdness

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not; preseason talk with new OC Sean Mannion paying off.
